intro.text: An Alethi highlord ruling Vamah princedom as regent from the city of Revolar.

items.text: Paladar ruled the princedom while Highprince Vamah was at the Shattered Plains. His greed hurt Revolar, and darkeyes with the right to travel were often turned away; Moash knew his corruption from caravan trips.

After the parshmen took Revolar, Paladar made himself a leader among the captives, avoiding work and hoarding food for favoured lighteyes. He recruited soldiers among them and hoped the Alethi armies would retake the city.
When Old Guff brought Moash to him and Moash seemed unwell, Paladar had Ked see that Guff was beaten for incompetence.
